options.text: A detailed 50-page document required for all businesses
A written guide that acts like a GPS for your side hustle, showing where you’re headed and how to get there
A playlist of motivational songs to inspire your hustle
A list of products you want to buy for your business

correct_answer.text: A written guide that acts like a GPS for your side hustle, showing where you’re headed and how to get there

questions.question_text: What does the 'M' in SMART goals stand for?

options.text: Motivational
Measurable
Manageable
Marketable

questions.question_text: Why is budgeting important for a teen’s side hustle?

options.text: It helps you spend all your money on cool packaging
It ensures you make every dollar (or rupee) count by tracking costs and income
It guarantees you’ll make a profit immediately
It’s only necessary for big companies, not small hustles

correct_answer.text: It ensures you make every dollar (or rupee) count by tracking costs and income

questions.question_text: Which of the following is a good time management tip for balancing school and a side hustle?

options.text: Work on your hustle all night and skip sleep
Set specific hustle hours, like 1-2 hours a few days a week, to avoid clashing with schoolwork
Take on as many orders as possible, even during exam week
Ignore school deadlines to focus on your business

correct_answer.text: Set specific hustle hours, like 1-2 hours a few days a week, to avoid clashing with schoolwork

questions.question_text: What is a key part of a mini business model for a teen’s side hustle?

options.text: Writing a 100-page report on market trends
Outlining how you deliver your product or service to customers
Creating a playlist for motivation while working
Buying expensive equipment before starting

correct_answer.text: Outlining how you deliver your product or service to customers
